title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Talent Acquisition Specialist

**Location:** Noida, Sector 62 (Work from Office) **Experience:** 6 months – 1 year **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Department:** Human Resources / Talent Acquisition

About the Role

We are looking for an enthusiastic **Talent Acquisition Specialist** to join our HR team in Noida, Sector 62\. In this role, you will own the end\-to\-end recruitment cycle — from sourcing and screening to coordinating interviews and closing candidates. This is a great opportunity for an early\-career recruiter to sharpen their sourcing skills and build strong stakeholder relationships in a fast\-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the full recruitment life cycle for assigned open positions, from requirement gathering to offer roll\-out.
* Source candidates through job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed), social media, referrals, and internal databases.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial telephonic/video interviews to assess candidate fit.
* Coordinate and schedule interviews between candidates and hiring managers.
* Maintain and update the applicant tracking system (ATS) and recruitment trackers.
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future openings.
* Share regular updates and reports on hiring status with hiring managers and the HR lead.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the hiring process.
* Assist with employer branding activities and campus/walk\-in drives as needed.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline (HR/Business specialization preferred).
* 6 months to 1 year of hands\-on experience in recruitment / talent acquisition.
* Familiarity with job portals such as Naukri and LinkedIn.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills (written and verbal).
* Good organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple requisitions at once.
* Comfortable working from the office in Noida, Sector 62\.

Good to Have

* Experience recruiting for \[IT / Non\-IT / Sales / your domain] roles.
* Exposure to an Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Basic knowledge of Boolean search techniques.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹23,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Current CTC
* Expected CTC

Work Location: In person

title: Non-IT Recruiter
description:
Position Summary We are seeking an experienced Non\-IT Recruiter to manage end\-to\-end recruitment activities across various business functions. In this role, you will partner closely with your reporting manager to design and execute effective talent acquisition strategies, identify high\-quality candidates, and deliver an exceptional candidate experience. This is a fast\-paced and dynamic environment that rewards innovation, relationship building, and recruitment excellence.
  
Key Responsibilities • Partner with the reporting manager to understand hiring needs and deliver recruitment goals within defined timelines. • Create and manage job postings across job boards, social media channels, ATS platforms, and other sourcing avenues. • Develop sourcing strategies and role\-specific assessment criteria based on market insights and recruitment trends. • Build strong partnerships with hiring managers to understand current and future hiring requirements. • Source top talent using job boards, social platforms, professional networks, and other recruitment channels. • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer management, and onboarding support. • Conduct candidate assessments, schedule interviews, and facilitate offer discussions and negotiations. • Develop and maintain strong candidate relationships to build robust talent pipelines. • Track recruitment metrics and implement process improvements to enhance hiring outcomes. • Ensure compliance with applicable employment laws, regulations, and company policies.
  
Qualifications \& Experience • 4\-7 years of experience in end\-to\-end recruitment. • Experience hiring for BPO, customer service, and other non\-technical operation roles. • Proven track record in both niche hiring and high\-volume recruitment. • Experience in employer branding initiatives through LinkedIn and other social media platforms. • Strong sourcing and talent\-mapping capabilities. • Experience with social recruiting, candidate engagement, and talent intelligence. • Demonstrated success with offer management and negotiations. • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. • Experience in conducting weekend walk\-in drives • Strong interviewing, assessment, and stakeholder management skills. • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, reporting, and recruitment analytics.

title: Senior Technical Recruiter
description:
**Position Overview:**
We at ShyftLabs, are seeking a highly skilled Senior Technical Recruiter to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and hiring top technical talent across various domains. Your deep understanding of technical concepts and industry trends will be essential in evaluating and attracting high\-caliber candidates in the competitive tech landscape.

ShyftLabs is a growing data product company that was founded in early 2020 and works primarily with Fortune 500 companies. We deliver digital solutions built to help accelerate the growth of businesses in various industries, by focusing on creating value through innovation.
### **Key Responsiblities:**

* Collaborate with hiring managers to understand role requirements and team need.
* Design and execute sourcing strategies to build pipelines of qualified candidates for technical roles.
* Leverage various platforms, networks, and creative sourcing methods to identify top talent.
* Conduct initial technical screenings to evaluate candidates' skills, experience, and cultural fit.
* Guide candidates through our hiring process.
* Monitor market trends closely and frame quarterly approach.

### **Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 4\+ years of experience in technical recruiting, preferably in high\-growth tech startup.
* Demonstrated success in sourcing and hiring for technical roles such as SDE, DevOps, Data Scientists \& more.
* Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) like Lever or Workday.
* Knowledge of technical concepts, programming languages (e.g., Java, Python, SQL), and software development methodologies.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Technical background or hands\-on experience in IT or software development is a plus.
* Strong time management and organization skills.
* Experience hiring for niche roles in areas like machine learning, cybersecurity, or apache druid.

We are proud to offer a competitive salary alongside a strong insurance package. We pride ourselves on the growth of our employees, offering extensive learning and development resources. This role is for on\-site joining from our Noida office location.
